scope: Ten exact root-relative path lookups per sample against 10000 prebuilt record targets; includes path normalization and result allocation, excludes record/source loading, parsing, index construction, authorization, validation, CEL, query execution, and serialization

build.patch: Compact link target index, differential tests and benchmark committed with this artifact
build.profile: Cargo release defaults; no profile overrides or RUSTFLAGS

method.fixture: 10000 deterministic in-memory records notes/n00000.md through notes/n09999.md, each with 4096-byte body; ten parsed root-relative path links to records 9990 through 9999
method.cache_state: records, parsed targets and compact index prebuilt once; no disk cache or result memoization
method.linear_scan: Independent scan oracle preserves former exact-path matching behavior, traversing nearly all records for each deliberately late match
method.indexed: The production resolver checks exact normalized paths in a BTreeMap

limitations: Component fixture is not the public 10K/100K Markdown acceptance corpus
Deliberately late-match exact-path workload is not a representative mixed query or traversal workload
No end-to-end latency, write durability, concurrent reader/writer, memory, or scaling acceptance gate evaluated
CPU frequency, power state and unrelated host activity uncontrolled; one sequential development-machine run
No timing claim for index construction, body parsing, basename ambiguity groups, ID resolution or target-type checks; separate differential tests cover their semantics
CEL link/asFile lookups use a separate implementation and remain outside this optimization
